ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite and drone imagery monitoring platform for industrial agricultural land and supply chain ESG compliance, automatically detecting land use violations and yield discrepancies.
ideas.title: AgriCompliance-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors the technical execution seen in GeoNex-ATLAS, combining hard remote sensing ML with enterprise ESG reporting that appeals to industrial judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk-scoring and transaction-monitoring platform tailored for Indian micro-entrepreneurs and local supply chains to detect financial anomalies and fraudulent activities using graph intelligence.
ideas.title: LocalLedger-AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the complex graph-intelligence and AML risk detection architecture of Bito into an accessible tool for local businesses, fitting the entrepreneurship focus of Udbhav'26.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered institutional nutrition and wellness platform tailored for Indian college hostels and corporate cafeterias to optimize meal planning, reduce food waste, and deliver personalized health recommendations.
ideas.title: NutriFit-Corporate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Takes the winning formula of E-Foodiee and scales it into a B2B startup pitch, directly addressing local institutional inefficiencies that judges will immediately understand.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient acquisition, trust-building, and automated follow-up engine designed specifically for dental and specialized clinics across Tier-2 Indian cities.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven patient acquisition engine of Global-Smile, packaged cleanly with a 7-slide pitch deck ready for the Shark Tank round.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent sustainability platform for large engineering campuses like PCCOER to track, forecast, and reduce energy consumption using localized RAG and reinforcement learning.
ideas.title: CarbonTrace-Campus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the multi-agent student support patterns of Greennovation with a localized campus problem, making the live MVP demonstration highly relatable to the host college judges.
